## Produce plots based on subset of ring data analysis

### Libraries

```{r}
library(AgeReading)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
require(gridExtra)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(cowplot)
```

### Load data and results

```{r}
Amin=3;Amax=12
A = Amax-Amin+1
R = 14

dir = "../../save_results/"
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0.year500000.RData"))                     
load(paste0(dir,"fitcombsubring0.year200000.RData"))              
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0subring4.year200000.RData"))             
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0subring8.year200000.RData"))   
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0subread2.year200000.RData"))   

data(Herring_D_boot)
data(HerringSurvey)
```

### Calculating number at age

```{r}
Bootmean = Herring_D_boot[Herring_D_boot$BootstrapID<2,]
nunit = length(unique(Bootmean$unitstrat))
#Only using mean of bootstrap samples
for(i in 1:nunit)
{
  Bootmean$Abundance[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Abundance[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
  Bootmean$Biomass[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Biomass[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
}

#foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0.year)$xi1
#res0 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
load(paste0(dir,"res0fit0.RData"))

foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0subring.year)$xi1
res1 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0subring4.year)$xi1
res2 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0subring8.year)$xi1
res3 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0subread2.year)$xi1
res4 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
```

### Make plots

### Dummy for legend

```{r}
dummy_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(1:3, levels = 1:3),
  x = 1:3,
  y = 1:3
)
#cols <- c("steelblue", "firebrick", "darkgreen")
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(3)
legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Full data","1/4 of exercise data","1/8 of exercise data")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      override.aes = list(shape=15,size = 6)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```


```{r}
y = 2
mean0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean3 = round(apply(res3[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd3 = round(apply(res3[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)

l = list()
ind = 0
y = 2
for(a in 3:5)
{
  ind = ind+1
  df = data.frame(y=c(res0[,y,a],res2[,y,a],res3[,y,a]),
                  Method=c(rep(1,dim(res0)[1]),
                       rep(2,dim(res2)[1]),rep(3,dim(res3)[1])))
  df$y = df$y/10^9
  df$Method = as.factor(df$Method)
  l[[ind]] = ggplot(df,aes(x=y,color=Method,fill=Method)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Age=",a+Amin-1)) + xlab('') + ylab('') +
    scale_color_discrete(
      labels = c(
        paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
        paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"),
        paste0(mean3[a],"(",sd3[a],")"))) +
    scale_fill_discrete(
      labels = c(
        paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
        paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"),
        paste0(mean3[a],"(",sd3[a],")"))) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(title = NULL),
      fill  = guide_legend(title = NULL)
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = c(1,1),legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.text=element_text(size=10),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
          legend.title = element_blank())
}

pdf("Nest_age345_subring_2022.pdf",height=2.5,width=10)
grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],legend_grob,ncol=4,nrow=1)
dev.off()

```


```{r}
for(y in 1:2)
{
  l = list()
  ind = 0
  mean0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  mean1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  mean2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  mean3 = round(apply(res3[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd3 = round(apply(res3[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  
  for(a in 1:10)
  {
    ind = ind+1
    df = data.frame(y=c(res0[,y,a],res2[,y,a],res3[,y,a]),
                    Method=c(rep(1,dim(res0)[1]),
                             rep(2,dim(res2)[1]),rep(3,dim(res3)[1])))
    df$y = df$y/10^9
    df$Method = as.factor(df$Method)
    l[[ind]] = ggplot(df,aes(x=y,color=Method,fill=Method)) +
      geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Age=",a+Amin-1)) + xlab('') + ylab('') +
      scale_color_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"),
          paste0(mean3[a],"(",sd3[a],")"))) +
      scale_fill_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"),
          paste0(mean3[a],"(",sd3[a],")"))) +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(title = NULL),
        fill  = guide_legend(title = NULL)
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = c(1,1),legend.justification = c(1, 1),
            legend.text=element_text(size=10),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
            legend.title = element_blank())
  }
  l[[11]] = legend_grob
  
  pdf(paste0("Nest_subring_202",y,".pdf"),height=5,width=10)
  grid.arrange(grobs=l,layout_matrix(c(1:8,NA,9:11),nrow=3,byrow=T))
  dev.off()
}
```


### Plot for subset of readers

```{r}
dummy_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(1:2, levels = 1:2),
  x = 1:2,
  y = 1:2
)
#cols <- c("steelblue", "firebrick", "darkgreen")
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(3)
legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Full data","3 readers")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      override.aes = list(shape=15,size = 6)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

legend_grob2 <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```


```{r}
for(y in 2)
{
  l = list()
  ind = 0
  mean0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  mean4 = round(apply(res4[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
  sd4 = round(apply(res4[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
  
  for(a in 3:5)
  {
    ind = ind+1
    df = data.frame(y=c(res0[,y,a],res4[,y,a]),
                    Method=c(rep(1,dim(res0)[1]),
                             rep(4,dim(res4)[1])))
    df$y = df$y/10^9
    df$Method = as.factor(df$Method)
    l[[ind]] = ggplot(df,aes(x=y,color=Method,fill=Method)) +
      geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Age=",a+Amin-1)) + xlab('') + ylab('') +
      scale_color_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean4[a],"(",sd4[a],")"))) +
      scale_fill_discrete(
        labels = c(
          paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
          paste0(mean4[a],"(",sd4[a],")"))) +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(title = NULL),
        fill  = guide_legend(title = NULL)
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = c(1,1),legend.justification = c(1, 1),
            legend.text=element_text(size=10),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
            legend.title = element_blank())
  }
  l[[4]] = legend_grob2
  
  pdf(paste0("Nest_age345_subread_202",y,".pdf"),height=2.5,width=10)
  grid.arrange(grobs=l,layout_matrix=matrix(c(1:4),nrow=1,ncol=4,byrow=T))
  dev.off()
}
```
